# C++ Coding Instructions

Apply these rules to all C++ files in this repository.

- Use `//` comments instead of block comments (`/* ... */`) unless block comments are strictly necessary.
- Prefer `constexpr`, `const`, and modern C++ constructs over `#define` for constants.
- Use tabs for indentation with a visual width of 4 spaces.
- Put opening braces on a new line for conditional and loop statements (`if`, `else`, `for`, `while`, `do`, `switch`).
- Add concise comments for non-obvious logic blocks.
- Add comments for global variables and global-scope methods/functions.
- In classes, prefix member variables with `m_`.
- In classes, prefix static member variables with `s_`.
